author: MonkeySlap
body:
Sup ya'll! Lookin' for an Avicus team to join. I'm an amazing PvPer and I'm a killer defender with new techniques and possibilities. I'm an actor by trade, so I'm good at psyching out the enemy, or making them believe something that isn't true (decoys). PLEASE reply to this if you're either lookin' for a new member, or if you want to know more about me.


About me:
  • I've been playing on Avicus since it was called WallsMC
  • I work well with teammates
  • Natural Leader
  • Master strategist
  • Top notch decoy line (Suicide squad, I rush forward and draw fire)
  • I own MedievalCraft ([REDACTED]; Come visit me)

If you're interested, then please reply below for a Swanky New Teammate!

I can hardly wait to start!

Talk to ya'lls later!

-MonkeySlap
